managePayments.keyMismatch.title: The Stripe keys do not match
managePayments.keyMismatch.body: This site’s server is using the {server, select, live {real payments} other {test}} Stripe key, while the browser was built with the {browser, select, live {real payments} other {test}} key. Card payments would fail when a customer tries to pay, so Stripe setup is blocked until those keys match.
managePayments.keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be set for the same environment, then the site rebuilt — the public key (publishable key) is put in when the site is built, and the secret key is read on every request.
managePayments.permission.title: Only the food truck’s owner can set up payments
managePayments.permission.body: Stripe is connected by the person whose bank account receives the money, so it must be set up from their own account while logged in. There is no problem at all with this food truck or with HatchGrab.

manageWhatsApp.blocked.body: WhatsApp is refusing to send your auto-replies because of a billing problem on your WhatsApp Business account. Customers can still message you and you will still see everything they send — but they are not getting a reply.

manageWhatsApp.billing.heading: Billing

manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesTitle: Meta is who charges for WhatsApp replies, not HatchGrab.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesBody: Each reply HatchGrab sends on your behalf is charged by Meta to your WhatsApp Business account. From {from}, Meta includes {free, number} free replies a month per number; after that, each reply is charged at Meta’s price. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app are not charged. Meta is who sets these prices and may change them. <link>See Meta’s prices</link>

manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveGeneral: Your limit is above Meta’s {free, number} free replies. Replies beyond those need a payment method on your WhatsApp account; without one, Meta stops all replies once the free ones have been used.
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.title: Would you like to disconnect WhatsApp?
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.body: Auto-replies stop at once and HatchGrab loses access to your WhatsApp account. Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app. To remove HatchGrab completely, also open WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.

customDomain.providers.cloudflare.open: Open your website address, then “DNS” and “Records”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.add: Select “Add record”, then choose “CNAME” as the “Type”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.value: Put the second value below in “Target”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.proxy: Set “Proxy status” to “DNS only” — the cloud beside it must be grey, not orange.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.caveat: If the cloud stays orange, the padlock will never appear, and nothing will explain why.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.open: Open your “Domain Portfolio” then choose your website address.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.add: Select “Add New Record”, then choose “CNAME” in the “Type” menu.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.save: Leave “TTL” as it is then select “Save”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one at the same time, the button says “Save All Records”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.signIn: Sign in to your “123 Reg Control Panel”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.manage: Beside “Domains”, select “Manage All”, then choose your website address.
customDomain.providers.123reg.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.value: Put the second value below in “Value”, and add a full stop at the end of it.
customDomain.providers.123reg.caveat: 123 Reg needs a full stop at the end of the second value, otherwise it will not work.
customDomain.providers.wix.open: Open “Domains”, then click the “Domain Actions” icon beside your website address.
customDomain.providers.wix.add: In the “CNAME (Aliases)” section, click “+ Add Record”, then click “Got it”.
customDomain.providers.wix.name: Put the first value below in “Host Name”.
customDomain.providers.wix.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.wix.save: Click “Save”, then click “Save Changes” in the pop-up window.
customDomain.providers.wix.caveat: If your website address only points to Wix instead of being held there, Wix cannot make this change — whoever holds it is the one who must make it.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.subject: One record to add for {truckName}’s schedule page
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introAt: We are putting {truckName}’s live schedule on {address}, and it needs one record added to our domain at {provider}.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introHold: We are putting {truckName}’s live schedule on {address}, and it needs one record added to our domain with whoever holds our domain.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.wholeChan: That is the whole change — nothing else on the website is affected, and the rest of our domain keeps working as it does now. It usually starts working within an hour.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.pointsAt: The page it points to shows where we will trade next and updates itself.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.replyTo: Reply to {email} if you have any questions.
customDomain.liveEmail.subject: The address {address} is working
customDomain.liveEmail.goodNews: Good news — the address {address} is working.
customDomain.liveEmail.body: Your schedule is now showing at your own address. Look at it and make sure it is right: open {address}, make sure the events are yours and the dates look correct.
customDomain.liveEmail.confirm: Once you have done that, open your settings on HatchGrab and tell us that it is right. Nothing depends on that — it just means we know a person has seen it.
